verses.text: A praise psalm Let everyone everywhere shine with praise to Yahweh! Let it all out! Go ahead and praise him!

footnotes.text: The word for “praise” is taken from the word shine.

verses.text: For he has conquered us with his great love and his kindness has melted our hearts. His faithfulness lasts forever and he will never fail you. So go ahead, let it all out! Praise Yah! O Yah!

footnotes.text: The name Yah is not an abbreviated form of Yahweh; it is the name of God as he displays his power. Yahweh is found 6,830 times in the Hebrew text, and Yah is found 49 times.
